segments.caption: In a brightly lit, minimalist studio with a distinctive orange logo on the wall, a man in a black suit approaches a sleek, white, three-wheeled concept vehicle. He opens the driver's side door and gets inside, then closes the door, leaving the vehicle alone on a circular platform as the camera holds on its futuristic, aerodynamic design.

In a stark, white studio with an orange circular floor marking and a logo on the back wall, a futuristic, white three-wheeled electric car is displayed. The vehicle, with its sleek, minimalist design and single front wheel, remains stationary as the camera focuses on it. The scene then cuts to a close-up of Danny Kim, identified by on-screen text as the Founder and CTO of Lit Motors, who appears to be speaking about the vehicle beside it. The segment

Danny Kim, Founder and CTO of Lit Motors, is speaking in an interview setting next to a white, futuristic two-wheeled electric vehicle. The camera then cuts to a close-up shot of the vehicle's front wheel, highlighting its design and tire.

A sleek, futuristic white Audi concept car rotates on a circular platform in a clean, well-lit studio, revealing its aerodynamic, minimalist design. A man in a dark suit enters the vehicle through its unconventional door, demonstrating the car’s unique, single-seater, scooter-like configuration.
A man exits a sleek, white, futuristic Audi concept car in a showroom setting, then turns to speak to the camera while standing beside the vehicle.

A man with glasses stands beside a sleek, white, futuristic-looking vehicle in what appears to be a workshop or garage, speaking as the camera pans to reveal the car's unique, bubble-like cockpit and the surrounding work environment.

A man stands in a workshop beside a sleek, white, futuristic-looking vehicle, which appears to be a custom-built electric car or prototype. The camera then moves inside, revealing a complex and exposed interior filled with wiring, electronic components, and a visible steering wheel, highlighting the vehicle’s unfinished, DIY nature as it sits in a cluttered garage.

The video shows the process of modifying a car's braking system. It begins with a close-up of the car's exposed brake assembly, then transitions to a person holding up a new, aftermarket brake rotor with a blue center. The scene then cuts to a wide shot from the driver’s perspective as the car drives down a palm-lined street, suggesting the modification is part of a performance upgrade for the vehicle.

A small, white, two-wheeled vehicle, resembling a futuristic scooter or microcar, is shown navigating a street lined with palm trees and parked cars. The scene shifts to show the vehicle in motion, seemingly avoiding or narrowly escaping a collision with a grey car that is crossing its path. The video then cuts to a man in glasses speaking, likely providing commentary or an explanation about the vehicle or the incident that just occurred.

A man stands beside a white car, introducing a custom-built vehicle with a unique, exposed mechanical design. The car's interior reveals a striking, DIY-style setup featuring two large, silver flywheel-like components mounted in a metal frame, connected by wiring to a battery pack. The vehicle's exterior showcases a sleek, minimalist aesthetic with a prominent black rear fender and a distinctive, angular rear spoiler, highlighting its unconventional engineering and aesthetic.

A futuristic white vehicle's undercarriage is shown deploying a sleek, black, articulated mechanical arm that extends between its wheels. The arm unfolds to reveal a compact, modular energy storage and regeneration system, which then activates as the vehicle accelerates. Text on screen confirms the system is in "Regeneration" mode while accelerating to 15 MPH, highlighting the vehicle's advanced energy recovery technology.

The segment showcases the development of a custom electric vehicle, beginning with animated diagrams illustrating its regenerative braking system and acceleration capabilities up to 25 MPH. The view then transitions to the real-world build, revealing the vehicle’s interior with a custom MOMO steering wheel and exposed wiring, highlighting the hands-on assembly process in a workshop setting.

The video segment begins with a close-up shot inside a car's cockpit, showcasing a black MOMO steering wheel and exposed wiring, indicating a vehicle in the midst of a build or modification. The scene then cuts to a man with glasses, wearing a dark jacket, who is speaking while standing next to the side of a white car, likely explaining the project or his work. The context suggests a behind-the-scenes look at a car customization or restoration process.

A man with glasses and dark clothing is speaking while seated next to the front passenger side of a white car, likely giving an interview or review. His head moves slightly as he talks, and the consistent background and framing suggest a continuous take.
A man in glasses speaks beside a white, futuristic, single-wheeled three-wheeled vehicle, which then drives away down a city street.

The scene then transitions to the vehicle’s interior, revealing a complex and exposed mechanical and electrical system with a dense network of wires and components, suggesting it is either under construction, being modified, or is a prototype. The focus remains on the intricate inner workings, highlighting the vehicle’s custom-built nature.

The vehicle's unique configuration, featuring two wheels at the rear and one at the front, is highlighted as it navigates traffic alongside buses and other cars, demonstrating its real-world mobility.
